text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a year of training focused on 
physical conditioning, her body is now 
primed to bring out her full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things are kicking off in earnest at last. 
Setting our sights on the Sprinters 
Stakes, where Biko Pegasus is apparently 
running too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public viewed their matchup with 
curious eyes, calling it a cute battle 
between a mismatched duo. However, Hishi 
Akebono didn't mind one bit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She declared with conviction that if 
people just watched the race, the heated 
competition would thrill them to no end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of running 
tirelessly towards the Sprinters Stakes 
alongside her precious rival, Biko 
Pegasus!
